claims: Artemis II is scheduled for no earlier than April 2026.
Artemis II marks the first crewed lunar mission since 1972.
Artemis II will launch from Kennedy Space Center's Pad 39B.
Artemis II will launch using the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis II is scheduled for early April 2026 (net).
Artemis II will send four astronauts around the Moon.
Northrop Grumman CRS-24 is scheduled for early April 2026.
Northrop Grumman CRS-24 will launch via SpaceX Falcon 9.
Northrop Grumman CRS-24 will deliver science and supplies to the ISS.
Artemis III is scheduled for June 2027 (long-term).
Artemis III aims to land astronauts on the moon.
